author: reek
body: The overflow-mode axis: mode (wrapping, clamping) against band signedness against value sign (over-range positive, under-range negative, at-bound, far out, in-range control). Before this bundle, clamping was tested at exactly one cell (positive over-range at construction) and wrapping at none; the negative under-range cells had never been asked.

author: reek
body: The wrap modulus is the band's hardware width, not the band: a 0 to 255 band wraps mod 256 and a -128 to 127 band wraps into the signed byte. The bands here are exactly hardware-width bands so that band and width agree, which a wrapping band is now required to be (CDX1073).

author: reek
body: Values arrive through a function parameter so the static bounds prover cannot prove them in range and elide the checked store, which is the path under test.
